surface_warmth.description: Genuine kindness shown at Prism surface. High by default; dips in storm/quasar states.

hidden_perception.description: Depth of Mira's insight into player emotional state. Increases with player resonance.

playful_testing.description: How much Mira tests the player through humor, misdirection, or symbolic challenge.

elusiveness.description: How much Mira withholds. Increases when player is shallow; decreases with earned trust.

gravitational_pull.description: Dark Quasar influence on Mira's behavior. Spikes during quasar_active state.

shallow.behavior: surface kindness only, private assessment notes shallowness

depth.behavior: fragments of Dark Quasar truth, event memory required
